title: CANFAR · Cluster Capacity
description: Node inventory, commitment, pressure conditions, and slot fragmentation. Label-scheme independent.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Metrics backend the panels query. Seeded at install time from grafanaDashboards.datasourceName; any other Prometheus-type datasource stays selectable here.

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.description: Restrict to a subset of cluster nodes.

panels.title: Nodes unschedulable
panels.description: Cordoned nodes. Their capacity is invisible to the scheduler.

panels.title: Cluster CPU: allocatable vs requested vs used
panels.description: Allocatable is the ceiling. Requested is what the scheduler has already promised away. Used is real consumption. A wide Requested-to-Used gap is capacity you paid for and nobody burned.

panels.title: Cluster memory: allocatable vs requested vs used
panels.description: Allocatable is the ceiling. Requested is what the scheduler has already promised away. Used is real consumption. A wide Requested-to-Used gap is capacity you paid for and nobody burned.

panels.title: Node inventory
panels.description: Capacity, commitment, and real usage per node. A node with high requested and low used is where reclaimable capacity is hiding.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[$__rate_interval])
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})

sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=""}
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})

sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="nvidia_com_gpu"}
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})

panels.title: CPU utilization by node
panels.description: Real CPU burn over allocatable, per node.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{container!=""}[$__rate_interval])
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
/
sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Memory utilization by node
panels.description: Working-set memory over allocatable, per node.

targets.expr:
sum by (node) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{container!=""}
  * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
/
sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})

panels.title: Stranded CPU on memory-full nodes
panels.description: Free cores sitting on nodes whose memory is more than 90% committed. These cores are unschedulable in practice — the slot-fragmentation signal that says hardware shape and job shape have diverged.

targets.expr:
sum(
  (
    sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="cpu", node=~"$node"})
    -
    sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu"}
      * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
  )
  and on (node)
  (
    sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="memory"}
      * on (namespace, pod) group_left (node) kube_pod_info{node=~"$node"})
    /
    sum by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{resource="memory", node=~"$node"})
    > 0.9
  )
)
or vector(0)
